articles.title: Senator Lummis: Ethics, other provisions in crypto Clarity Act to be further discussed
articles.snippet: Senator Cynthia Lummis, one of the lead negotiators on the bill, told CoinDesk she was "pleased" that the updated bill was ready for release.

articles.title: Galaxy Commits Up to $5 Million to Prepare Bitcoin for Quantum Threat
articles.snippet: The crypto firm's initiative arrives as researchers, exchanges, and the U.S. government warn that "Q-Day" may land as soon as 2030.
